A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, Low-dimensional topology of deep neural networks. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and appendices A–I are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 6 and Appendices G and I report original neural-network classification experiments on synthetic linked configurations and CIFAR-10, including accuracy measurements and linking analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original synthetic-data and CIFAR-10 experiments, including the quantitative results in Tables 2–8 and the appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The network architectures, folding constructions, and Algorithm 1 linking detector remain unchanged. The rewritten attention explanation retains the same two-token construction and implementation described in Appendix F.4.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same thickened Hopf links, disk–annulus task, higher-dimensional linked spheres, and CIFAR-10 binary and ten-class tasks. Section 6.5 clarifies the sphere geometry without adding or changing evaluated data.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same comparators: ReLU versus GELU, plain ReLU versus ResNet, the four architectures in Table 4, and the seven CIFAR-10 activations with the same skip-connection comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported splits, network widths and depths, training schedules, metrics, and detection procedures remain unchanged in Section 6 and Appendices G–I. No revised evaluation protocol is reported.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the depth and width sweeps, link-copy scaling, ResNet visualization, layerwise linking and distance tracking, and CIFAR-10 localization and projection controls. Expanded explanatory prose introduces no additional analysis.

E5.justification: Seed counts, means, standard deviations, maxima, detection repetitions, and correlation significance reporting are unchanged. Expanding 'std' to 'standard deviation' or 'std dev' in Tables 2–3 changes labeling only.

E6.justification: Tables 2–8, appendix statistics, and empirical figure content retain the same results. For example, Table 2 still reports GELU maxima of 100.0% at depths 5, 8, and 12, and Table 5 retains the 1.2% linked-pair gap.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, constructions, and proofs remain substantively unchanged. Theorem 5.3 is shortened, but its local V-shape and affine-rescaling details remain in the accompanying explanation; Appendix F.4 retains the same construction.

C1.justification: The abstract and four stated contributions retain the same scope: linking obstructions, architectural folding mechanisms, empirical validation, and extrinsic linking detection. The rewritten conclusion emphasizes these existing contributions without introducing a new central claim.

C2.justification: Section 6.2 more precisely associates overcoming the barrier with GELU's 100% best runs; v1 attached barrier-breaking language to approximately 90% performance. The expanded dimensional explanation restates Appendix G.5, while the CIFAR-10 causal, projection, and optimization caveats remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The code-access pointer, architecture specifications, hyperparameters, data-generation recipes, and linking-detector settings are retained. Appendices A–I contain no substantive additions or removals of reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to topology, approximation theory, and earlier neural-network research remain unchanged. Removed bibliography annotations concern awards or informal descriptions, rather than comparator membership or research positioning.

P1.justification: Several passages in Sections 5–6 and the conclusion are rephrased, with clearer linked-sphere explanations and standardized terminology. Bibliography annotations are trimmed. The section sequence and overall narrative structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 6 receives an expanded caption explaining the point–circle and winding-number interpretation. Figure 7 moves from page 8 to page 9, Table 6 shifts position, and Tables 2–3 receive label adjustments. The same scientific figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves clarity: Figure 6 explains previously terse notation, Section 6.5 distinguishes linked spheres from nested spheres, and Section 6.2 connects barrier-breaking more clearly to the best-run results. These refinements aid interpretation; the underlying methods, proofs, and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
